designationHistory.indexText: Two Rivers National Wildlife Refuge was originally established in 1946 as part of the Upper Mississippi River National Wildlife and Fish Refuge to protect and enhance habitat for migratory birds.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Two Rivers National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: FWS's own history gives the 1940s and early 1950s for the original divisions, not a single 1946 date, and no independent source was found. The refuge took its current form in 1958 (Brussels District) and its name in 2000. Choose which event the directory treats as establishment and confirm from the CCP.
